Want to speed up your coloring process? Here’s a quick and easy method to get pro-level results fast! 1️⃣ Create a Mask – Cover your entire character with a base mask. 2️⃣ Block in Colors – Use the mask to quickly paint key areas like hair, beard, eyes, and scars. 3️⃣ Add Color Variation – Bring life to your character by adding subtle reds on the shoulders, elbows, ears, nose, and around the eyes. 4️⃣ Shading Made Easy – Clip a new layer, paint with purple, blue, or red, and set it to Multiply mode. Adjust opacity if needed. 5️⃣ Gradient & Texture – Add a slight gradient to the lower parts of the character and throw in some halftone dots for a comic-style effect. 6️⃣ Final Touches – Create a rim light behind the character for depth, then blend everything with an airbrush for a polished look. ⚡ And that’s it! The quickest (and laziest) way to color your characters while still making them look amazing.
